title: Records Management System Southeastern Power
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF > ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF > SOUTHEASTERN POWER ADMINISTRATION
description:
Southeastern Power Administration (SEPA) is seeking information from qualified vendors with proven expertise in providing an onsite Records Management System (RMS) to perform the automated processes to manage temporary and permanent records for SEPA. Information gathered in response to this request will be used in assessing and aiding in the selection process for our final Records Management System selection. 

 THIS IS A REQUEST FOR IFORMATION(RFI) NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPSALS (RFP). NO SOLICITATION IS AVALABLE AT THIS TIME. 

 The attached RFI gives a brief intrducton and background into what SEPA is ultimatey looking for and hoping to acomplkish. A more in-depth description for accomplishing the listed work tasks will be given in the SOW once posted for bid. 

  SUBMISSION DETAILS  
All Interested parties, please submit your response to this RFI via email to the Contracting Officer listed in section 5 (Juvonna Mattox), no later than  12PM Eastern Time December 8th, 2026 . When submitting your response, please just send an email include a brief description of your company, email  subject line: RESPONSE TO RFI 89503511242026 , and all relevant contact information. we will contact you via email in order to setup a time for a conference.
